facts.text: The resort is on Maamunagau Island in Raa Atoll, Republic of Maldives.
facts.excerpt: MAAMUNAGAU ISLAND RAA ATOLL, REPUBLIC OF MALDIVES

facts.text: Guests arrive by seaplane to the shores of Raa Atoll.
facts.excerpt: be mesmerised by island life from the moment you board the seaplane to the tranquil shores of the Raa Atoll

facts.text: The resort sits close to the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, with a manta ray sanctuary adjacent to the resort.
facts.excerpt: Nestled close to the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, prepare to be amazed by the myriad of marine life in our lagoon including a unique manta ray sanctuary adjacent to this luxury resort in Maldives.

facts.text: Reef manta rays feed in Maamunagau Lagoon during the Northeast Monsoon months, December to April, and the lagoon is a nursery ground for juvenile mantas.
facts.excerpt: Witness the majestic reef manta rays during Northeast Monsoonal months (Dec-April), as they feed in Maamunagau Lagoon. This lagoon also serves as a vital nursery ground for juvenile mantas.

facts.text: Guests can explore the marine life of Raa Atoll with the Manta Trust.
facts.excerpt: Explore the marine life in and around Raa Atoll with the Manta Trust

facts.text: The recreation programme includes Hanifaru Bay, best visited at new and full moons from June to November for manta rays and whale sharks.
facts.excerpt: Visit during New Moons and Full Moons(June-November) for a plankton-rich spectacle with over 100 mantas and whale sharks

facts.text: Sea turtles nest on Maamunagau Island, and the resort protects their nests.
facts.excerpt: Maamunagau Island is a haven for sea turtles. We protect their nests and witness the incredible journey of hatchlings to the ocean.

facts.text: The house reef is steps from the beach.
facts.excerpt: Explore our vibrant house reef just steps from the beach, teeming with diverse coral species.

facts.text: A guided snorkelling trip near Maamunagau Island goes to see nurse sharks.
facts.excerpt: Discover a guided snorkelling experience just moments from Maamunagau Island, where nurse sharks are often seen gliding through calm, crystal-clear waters.

facts.text: A large lagoon surrounds the entire island, with snorkelling spots home to black tip reef sharks, dolphins and turtles.
facts.excerpt: Our island is blessed with a large lagoon which surrounds the entire island and is home to several snorkelling spots, thriving with diverse fish, black tip reef sharks, dolphins and turtles.

facts.text: Dolphin cruises go out on a dhoni.
facts.excerpt: Set sail on a dhoni cruise in search of playful dolphins.

facts.text: Guests can take a private luxury yacht trip with chef-curated bites.
facts.excerpt: Escape beyond the shoreline on your own luxury yacht, where time slows and the horizon feels endless. With personalised service, fine pours, and chef-curated bites

facts.text: Sandbank experiences take guests to a sandbank surrounded by the Indian Ocean.
facts.excerpt: escape to a sandbank surrounded by the crystal clear Indian Ocean

facts.text: AVI Spa is an overwater spa with six overwater treatment villas.
facts.excerpt: An overwhelming feeling of calm permeates throughout the six overwater treatment villas

facts.text: AVI means sunshine in the local language.
facts.excerpt: Meaning “sunshine” in the language of our island home

facts.text: AVI Spa treatments use brands such as The Organic Pharmacy, VitaJuwel Crystal Gemstones, Biologique Recherche and Margaret Dabbs products.
facts.excerpt: Discover unique therapies or indulge in signature treatments using leading wellness brands such as The Organic Pharmacy, VitaJuwel Crystal Gemstones,  Biologique Recherche and Margret Dabb’s Pure Products.

facts.text: AVI Spa was named Luxury Island Resort Spa at the World Luxury Spa Awards 2020.
facts.excerpt: AVI Spa has recently been adjudged “Luxury Island Resort Spa” at the World Luxury Spa Awards 2020

facts.text: The resort runs a visiting wellness practitioner programme.
facts.excerpt: The wellness visiting practitioners programme at InterContinental Maldives Maamunagau Resort aims to provide our guests with an opportunity to discover new ways of wellness

facts.text: Yoga takes place in an ocean-facing yoga pavilion and at scenic points around the island, from Hatha to aerial yoga.
facts.excerpt: stretch, strengthen or meditate in the tranquility of our ocean-facing yoga pavilion and the different scenic points of the island. From Hatha Yoga to Arial Yoga

facts.text: Wellness sessions include Aqua Yoga and Floating Sound Therapy in the water.
facts.excerpt: Drift into a quieter state with Floating Sound Therapy, a water-based session designed to release tension and settle the senses.

facts.text: Guests have complimentary access to the padel tennis court, with rackets, balls, towels and water provided.
facts.excerpt: guests can enjoy complimentary access to the court, with rackets, balls, towels and water provided

facts.text: All guests enjoy complimentary Club InterContinental benefits.
facts.excerpt: All guests enjoy complimentary club benefits.

facts.text: As an all-Club InterContinental resort, complimentary benefits range from a la carte breakfast to a multi-tiered afternoon tea and an evening aperitif.
facts.excerpt: As the first and only all-Club InterContinental® resort, enjoy complimentary benefits ranging from à la carte breakfast to a multi-tiered afternoon tea and tantalising evening aperitif.

facts.text: Club benefits include Private Seaplane Lounge Access.
facts.excerpt: your journey to paradise begins with a touch of exclusivity and convenience through Private Seaplane Lounge Access

facts.text: Each guest has an Island Curator as a dedicated guide to the island.
facts.excerpt: The Island Curator at InterContinental Maldives is your dedicated guide to unlocking the secrets of this tropical paradise.

facts.text: Club benefits include island bicycles for exploring the island.
facts.excerpt: the allure of exploring this tropical paradise on two wheels is made both convenient and enjoyable with their Island Bicycles

facts.text: The Retreat is an adults-only overwater enclave with sweeping lagoon views and a pool.
facts.excerpt: An adults-only enclave perched overwater with sweeping lagoon views, The Retreat is an idyllic setting to while away the day, beginning with a refreshing cocktail by the pool

facts.text: The Residence Collection offers multi-bedroom villas and residences for families and groups.
facts.excerpt: Multi-bedroom villas and residences for families and groups

facts.text: There are seven restaurants and bars.

facts.excerpt: Begin the evening with a 360-degree view of the resort and the Indian Ocean on top of the lighthouse before you sit down to vibrant flavours

facts.text: The Sunset Bar is a dhoni-shaped bar facing the sunset.
facts.excerpt: as you take in the sunset views at the helm of a dhoni-shaped bar

facts.text: Dining by Design offers private meals on a secluded beach, a remote sandbank or in the villa with a personal chef.
facts.excerpt: a range of intimate island settings from a secluded beach, a remote sandbank or the privacy of your villa with a curated menu and the service of a personal chef
